Measuring efficiency
Power usage effectiveness (PUE) is a ratio that
describes how efficiently a datacenter uses energy.
The lower the number, the better the score.
We design and build Microsoft datacenters as close
to a PUE of 1.0 as possible. This year our datacenters
delivered a design rating of 1.12 PUE and, with
each new generation, we will strive to be even
more efficient.
